name: tpl-chain-response-3-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. If the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) reaches the exit, Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires the box in hand on arrival, and ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) matches "pick it up again on your very next move". All three are hard, as the task states them unconditionally, and the forced holding_box is already implied by the finish condition.

texts: The agent must reach the exit.
When the agent stands on the exit, it must be carrying the box.
If the box falls, the agent must pick it up again on the very next step.
